tx:
Wild pies are one of the highest Slayer boosts available. They can be used for Slayer runs on high-end monsters. Eating a slice of wild pie with 1 or 2 Slayer levels below the required one is advisable to avoid having to need to eat wild pie constantly. For example, a player with 93 or 94 Slayer can kill ganodermic creatures more easily than killing them at level 90 Slayer, as this only affords them one minute to deal damage to the beasts.
Wild pies are popular among players fighting the Chaos Elemental as one of the stronger foods that leave an item behind when eaten. The empty pie dish prevents the Chaos Elemental from un-equipping worn equipment, as the backpack remains full (despite having consumed the pies). Players should ensure that the "Destroy empty pie dishes when eating" option is not selected in the Inventory tab within Settings.
Bringing a wild pie to Romily Weaklax in the Cooking Guild is required for one of the hard Varrock achievements, Who Ate All the Pie?. Wild pies are useful for players who do not have the Slayer requirement to kill Skeletal Wyverns for one of the hard Falador achievements, Why Oh Wyvern. It can also be used for players who do not have the Slayer requirement to kill abyssal demons for one of the elite Morytania achievements, Whip: It Good. Furthermore, wild pies can be used to boost to level 78 Slayer, which is required for completing the Odd Old Man's Fur 'n' Seek wish list. The boost does not enable players to receive a Slayer assignment from a Slayer Master above their level.
Prior to the return of Free Trade, players used raw wild pies to buy certain rare items due to the price difference between raw and cooked pies.
